stuck: Stuck? Type 'hint' for guidance or 'docs' to read the manual.
no_hints_for_level: No hints available for this level.
been_at_it_a_while: You've been at it a while. Type `docs {{cmd}}` to read about the commands you need.
look_at_repo_state: Try looking at the repository state first. Type `git status` or `git log` to understand what you're working with.
generic_error: Your last command `{{cmd}}` failed: {{output}}. Check the objectives and try a different approach.
error_not_a_git_repository: You need to initialize a git repository first. Try: git init
error_pathspec: The file you specified doesn't exist. Check the filename with: ls
error_nothing_to_commit: All your changes are already committed. Check: git status
error_conflict: There's a merge conflict. Use 'edit <file>' to resolve it, then 'git add <file>' and 'git commit'
error_not_a_valid_object: That commit hash doesn't exist. Use 'git log' to see available commits.
error_could_not_find: That branch or ref doesn't exist. Use 'git branch' to see available branches.
error_detached_head: You're in detached HEAD state. Create a branch to save your work: git checkout -b <name>
error_did_not_match_any_file: That file doesn't match anything. Check available files with: ls
error_not_something_we_can_merge: The branch you're trying to merge doesn't exist. Use 'git branch' to list branches.
error_already_exists: That name is already taken. Pick a different name or delete the existing one first.
error_is_not_a_commit: That doesn't point to a valid commit. Use 'git log' to find the right reference.
approach_merge: You're on the right track with git merge, but this level needs a different approach. Check the objectives again.
approach_rebase: You're on the right track with git rebase, but this level wants you to use a different strategy. Re-read the objectives.
approach_reset: git reset changes history, but this level might want you to preserve it. Consider git revert instead.
approach_revert: git revert creates a new commit to undo changes, but this level might want you to rewrite history. Consider git reset.
approach_checkout: git checkout works, but try using git switch — it's the modern way to change branches.
fallback_check_docs: Check the docs for guidance. Type `docs {{cmd}}` to read the manual.
fallback_review_objectives: Review the objectives panel and try re-reading the level briefing for clues.
